sources.summary: Located in the Escandón neighborhood of Mexico City, this 300-square-meter penthouse renovation by Barde vanVoltt reinterprets brutalist architecture through warmth, craftsmanship, and domestic comfort. Designed for two creative professionals, the project transforms an existing rooftop apartment into a calm sanctuary above one of the city's most vibrant districts.
